title: EXIF Missing Metadata Rate
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lightroom:photo
| eval missing=if(isnull(iso) OR isnull(focal_length_mm) OR isnull(aperture) OR isnull(shutter_speed),1,0)
| stats sum(missing) as missing_exif, count as photos by collection_name
| eval missing_pct=round(100*missing_exif/photos,1)
| sort - missing_pct
description: Measures how often key EXIF fields are absent from exported photo metadata by collection.
value: Incomplete metadata weakens later analysis of camera settings, lens choices, and keeper rates.
implementation: Retain core EXIF fields in Lightroom export sidecars and review collections with unusual metadata gaps.
visualization: Table of collections ranked by missing EXIF percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which photo sets are missing camera details you would want later when you review or learn from them.
